Title: Azure Cosmos DB—Now available in France preview

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB is now a part of the preview of Microsoft Azure in France, which is currently open to all customers and partners worldwide, giving them the opportunity to deploy services and test workloads against Azure Cosmos DB in the latest Azure regions. Azure Cosmos DB in the new region will offer the same enterprise-grade reliability and performance with the industry-leading comprehensive SLAs to support the mission-critical applications and workloads of businesses and organizations in France. 

Sign up for the Azure Cosmos DB France preview.

Learn more about Microsoft Azure in France.
